label: Source-bound operating boundary; not a laptop observation.

human-only.title: Human approval is separate
human-only.short: Copy only. Only human-selected local Workstation setup has the approved execution exception.
human-only.text: A shown command is not authorization. Humans may run tasks directly or select Workstation setup in local Windows VS Code, approve installation/Restore/launch scopes and answer native confirmations. Ordinary coding/build/desktop/cloud/subagents cannot do those actions. Repair, policy/source/account/profile changes, automatic elevation/restart, Git publication, cleanup and cloud execution remain outside that agent.

partial.title: Stopped partial is not success
partial.short: A force-closed Microsoft base is stopped partial, not completed setup or rollback.
partial.text: Do not use Finish/SkipBase after a stopped partial legacy base. Preserve tools, settings, accounts and distro data; establish vendor/reboot state and use reviewed installed-first inventory.

no-restore.title: Daily checks do not restore
no-restore.short: Installed runtime plus already restored dependencies are required. Missing means NOT RUN.
no-restore.text: Offline mode alone can restore cached dependencies. Use the repository dispatcher guards for daily Test/Lint/Coverage/Run; do not install or restore to turn an absent prerequisite into a green check.

cloud.title: Existing infrastructure only
cloud.short: Files-only preparation is not dispatch, authentication, provisioning or deployment.
cloud.text: Existing AKS/ACR, real inputs, trusted current main, same-run immutable digests and independently verified environment approval are required. Unavailable or unverifiable protections fail closed.
